summary: Kornit Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held August 31, 2026. Shareholders approved three routine proposals: re-election of two Class II directors and initial election of a third, adoption of a renewed executive compensation policy, and re-appointment of independent auditors. Quorum of 71.6% was achieved. No special-situation event such as merger, tender offer, or going-private transaction occurred.
